messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: updated Stan web pages
parts:
I rolled out a redesign of the web pages. Hopefully
they'll be easier to navigate. Highlights include

* Clearer route to get started (and donate) from home page

* NumFOCUS --- the nonprofit foundation with whom we are
now associated

* Moving all info for interfaces to the page for that interface

* Case Studies --- linked from documentation (more to follow soon
when we iron out the usual R and knitr and jekyll SNAFUs)

* Actual reference citations cleaned up and put into regular (not BibTeX)
format

* New pages for Math Library, Stan C++, StataStan, RStanArm, and ShinyStan

* No more timed delay on drop-down menu (we were getting complaints on speed)

Please let us know if something's not working or you have
suggestions for improvement.

- Bob

I tried it with caps and it looked odd to me. But if it
really matters to you, feel free to change them.
